positions.title: Staff Firmware Engineer
positions.locationName: Eden Prairie, Minnesota, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
Instructed and supervised student laboratory activities
Requested components for laboratory activities
Evaluated weekly homework assignments

positions.title: Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Ran simulations of a Power PC processor design and identified causes of failed test cases
Communicated and worked with other team members to correct the causes of simulation failures
Worked in a group with other coops to create the Circuit Technology 45th anniversary website

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Aided in the development and refinement of an automated software verification system
Helped develop a SQL database structure for software specifications

positions.title: Robotics Research Assistant
positions.description:
Worked in a team of 4 designing and programming a maze-solving robot
Designed and programmed a robot which recognized and responded to various colors
Observed the development of an autonomous submarine
